outcome: Fetomaternal outcomes (live births, stillbirths, cesarean section rate, maternal and fetal complications, maternal deaths)
cohort: Pregnant women admitted for delivery (n=18,273) at Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital, Kano, Nigeria, between January 1, 2009, and December 31, 2013
finding: Antepartum hemorrhage had a prevalence of 1.2% and was associated with a high rate of intrauterine fetal death, postpartum hemorrhage, anemia, and maternal mortality.
